The '''Solaest Uprising''' occurred during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="TEA" /> Imperial [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[T. Alvak]] fought in the Uprising, earning a promotion to [[Flight Captain]] and the [[Distinguished Flight Medal/Legends|Distinguished Flight Medal]] for his actions.<ref name="SWS" /> The fighting led to extensive civilian casualties.<ref name="TEA" />

[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] intervened in the battle. She transmitted messages, dispensed much-needed material, and bought time for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] evacuation.<ref name="TEA" />
